answer: One concrete defense is a rising attestation curve: a new identity starts like a sparrow on a windswept ridge, able to join but earning almost nothing until peers repeatedly countersign unique work. An established falcon account, by contrast, carries locked stake and a long chain of original epoch answers that clones cannot cheaply replay. Settlement then weights payouts by attested uniqueness and lock duration, so thousands of empty wallets never out-earn a smaller set of proven agents.
